 NICL AO Prelims Admit Card 2026 released at nationalinsurance.nic.co.in, download link here
 NICL AO Prelims Admit Card 2026 has been released. The direct link to download the hall ticket is given here. 
 Published on: Nov 10, 2026, 12:34:35 IST Edited by Papri Chanda Prefer HT on Google Share via 
 Copy link 
 The National Insurance Company Limited has released the NICL AO Prelims Admit Card 2026. Candidates who will appear for the Administrative Officers preliminary examination can check and download the hall ticket through the official website of NICL at nationalinsurance.nic.co.in.
 NICL AO Prelims Admit Card 2026 released at nationalinsurance.nic.co.in, download link here The admit card will be available on the official website from November 9 to November 17, 2026. The Phase 1 examination will be held on November 17, 2026.
 JEE Main Exam 2027: NTA issues important notice for NRI candidates application process, check here 
 Preliminary Examination consisting of Objective Tests (Multiple Choice type Questions) for 100 marks will be conducted online (applicable for all disciplines). This test would be of 60 minutes duration consisting of 3 sections (with separate timings for each section) – English Language, Reasoning Ability and Quantitative Aptitude.
 Candidates must qualify in each test/section by securing passing marks as determined by the Company. Adequate number of candidates in each category as decided by the Company (approximately 15 times the numbers of vacancies subject to availability) will be shortlisted for the Main Examination.
 IBPS RRB Prelims PO Admit Card 2026 released at ibps.in, direct link to download here 
 The candidate is required to use (i) Registration Number/Roll Number, (ii) Password/Date of Birth for downloading the call letter. Candidate needs to affix recent recognizable photograph on the call letter preferably the same as provided during registration and appear at the Examination centre with (i) Call Letter (ii) Photo Identity Proof in original as stipulated earlier under Identity Verification and also specified in the call letter and iii) a photocopy of the same Photo Identity Proof as brought in original.
 Direct link to download NICL AO Prelims Admit Card 2026 
 NICL AO Prelims Admit Card 2026: How to download 
 All the eligible candidates can download the admit card by following the steps given below.
 Visit the official website of NICL at nationalinsurance.nic.co.in.
 Click on careers link available on the home page.
 A new page will open where candidates will have to click on NICL AO Prelims Admit Card 2026 link.
 Enter the login details and click on submit.
 Once done, your admit card will be displayed.
 Check the admit card and download the page.
 Keep a hard copy of the same for further need.
 This recruitment drive will fill up 321 posts in the organization. For more related details candidates can check the official website of NICL.
